(default under lockdown is --network none; loopback always works).

jump-dev__jump.jl-2714._why: JuMP full suite measured 2m58 clean / 2m53 with source edit applied (idle box, --network none) — right AT the 300s cliff, so under real run load (3-4 concurrent tasks + grading) every historical run_tests timed out (68-call thrash). 600s = ~3.4x idle-measured, load-aware headroom.

juliadebug__cthulhu.jl-547._why: THREE defects: (1) Pkg.test() defaults to --check-bounds=yes which disables the @inbounds DCE the F2P test asserts (repo CI runs --check-bounds=auto); (2) the Manifest pins LoweredCodeUtils.jl as a git dep NOT baked into the image depot, so Pkg.test clones from github at test time — derived image pre-seeds the depot; (3) Julia prints per-testset summary rows ONLY on failure — a fully-PASSING suite shows a single aggregate 'runtests.jl' row, so the name-based parser can never credit the F2P/P2P names (structurally ungradeable-on-success). The `&& printf` tail emits a synthetic summary table for the 26 expected testset names IFF the suite exits 0 (aggregate pass logically implies every nested testset passed). Grading becomes all-or-nothing for this task (partial passes still grade NO) — documented degradation, strictly better than permanently-NO.

bitshifter__glam-rs-382._why: cargo test resolves the whole workspace (root glam + codegen + test_no_std members), and codegen's deps (anyhow/clap/git2/...) were never fetched, so cargo dies offline updating the crates.io index. Compounding: the image's default rustup toolchain is 1.84.1, but unlocked resolution today picks codegen-transitive crates (indexmap 2.14, home 0.5.12, tera 1.20.1, ...) that declare edition="2024", which 1.84.1's own manifest parser cannot parse at all (hard version gate, reproduces even fully offline/cached) — this task's own curated docker_specs.cargo_version is "1.89.0", so the derived image installs+defaults rustup to 1.89.0 (matches curation) and fetches under it. Verified offline: 305 passed, 0 failed (unit) + 5 passed (doctests).

jeltef__derive_more-387._why: cargo test --workspace --features full,testing-helpers needs feature-gated optional deps (serde_core 1.0.228 et al.) never fetched into the image's registry cache, so cargo dies offline updating the crates.io index. Derived image runs cargo fetch + the task's test_cmd at build time (network available). Verified offline: full suite runs to completion, only the expected base-state F2P (compile_fail, 5/80 sub-cases — the 'overflow evaluating requirement' Debug-recursion bug from the problem statement) fails.

serpro69__kotlin-faker-267._why: the image's install step ran ./gradlew ... -x test -x dokkaJavadoc, so the full `test` task's dokka plugin graph (org.jetbrains.dokka:dokka-base/javadoc-plugin/analysis-kotlin-descriptors:1.9.20) was never resolved into GRADLE_USER_HOME=/workspace/.gradle. Compounding: the image ships _JAVA_OPTIONS=-Djava.net.preferIPv6Addresses=true, but this docker bridge network has no IPv6 route (host does; container doesn't), so dependency resolution failed with 'Network is unreachable' even during the build-time warm attempt until forced to IPv4 (same fix as scalameta__scalameta-2550 in this same dockerfiles dir). Derived image sets preferIPv6Addresses=false and runs the task's actual test_cmd once at build time. Verified offline: 3234 tests, 3233 passed, 1 failed (RandomClassProviderTest — the sealed-class randomClassInstance F2P from the problem statement); zero network-resolution errors.
